description: Starter catalogue for parity-rs (parity-contracts 0.16.0). Copy it to the service's repository as logging/events.parity-rs.v1.json; the service owns it from then on.

request.handled.description: A tenant routing request was answered (one per request).

request.dead_lettered.description: A request without a valid id or reply_to was dead-lettered (attrs.reason).

saga.state_changed.description: A saga moved (cause: the input that moved it).

saga.finished.description: A saga ended (attrs.saga_outcome: done, aborted, cancelled, compensated, rolled_back, stopped).

placement.decided.description: place_tenant chose a zone and unit (decision: the candidate zones).

placement.write_retried.description: A placement write was sent again with the same id.

assignment.written.description: A tenant's assignment was written in the zone's etcd (attrs.epoch).

assignment.seeded.description: A missing assignment was written from the placement.

assignment.write_failed.description: An assignment write failed or lost its compare.

handover.reported.description: A per-tenant service reported a handover (attrs.reporter).

unit.changed.description: A unit's role, release, readiness or health changed.

rollout.auto_rollback.description: A failing canary started an automatic rollback.

leader.acquired.description: This instance became the zone's leader.

leader.lost.description: This instance lost the zone's leadership.

store_copy.ready.description: The copy of tenant.store.state reached its end offsets (attrs.revision).

drift.detected.description: An assignment names another unit than the placement, with no saga to explain it.

import.row_applied.description: The import job wrote one tenant_route row.

import.row_skipped.description: The import job kept what parity-store has (attrs.reason).

import.row_failed.description: The import job failed one row.
